text:
Mia Chen: FYI, enterprise prospect (Atlas Systems) asking for a 35% off list for a 12-month Dedicated commit. requested via AE earlier today.
Samir Patel: 35% sounds high — what's the committed $/month target?
Mia Chen: They'd commit to $120k/mo reserved capacity. currently on our standard tier pricing they'd be ~$185k/mo.
Julia Ramos: math check: 120/185 = ~0.65 -> ~35% yes. what concessions are they asking for besides $?
Mia Chen: They want 24/7 SRE on-call add-on included and 90-day SLA credit terms + net60 payment.
Carla Ng: Net60 for first-year enterprise? need CFO signoff. also SRE add-on usually charged at 15% uplift.
Samir Patel: Can we structure as: 30% discount base rate + bundling the SRE add-on at 10% (instead of 15%) and trial the net60 for Q1 only, then net30?
Mia Chen: AE says customer insists on net60 for the contract start or they walk. It's strategic — they feed into our marketplace partner.
Julia Ramos: If it's strategic, we can accept a one-time exception but need clear guardrails: 30% max, SRE bundled at 10%, legal to add auto-revert to net30 after 90 days, and finance hold retention clause until KYC completed.
Carla Ng: Need to see ARR runway. Approving 30% at $120k/mo = $36k discount/mo => $432k first year. Are we comfortable?
Samir Patel: We should ask for an accelerated payment schedule if they bump usage >1.5x. Also require up-front first invoice net30 to reduce exposure.
Mia Chen: AE is willing to take first invoice net30. I'll confirm.
BillingBot: invoice-alert: previously invoiced for Atlas Systems: last month usage $0 due to test account. no outstanding invoices on record.
Julia Ramos: OK if billing bot shows clean slate that's helpful. I can approve the pricing structure (30% + SRE @10%) pending legal clause for auto-revert to net30 and signed amendment.
Carla Ng: Finance pre-approval: provisional sign-off for 30% discount and bundled SRE as described. Final sign-off pending Legal & AP confirmation of net60 terms for Q1 only and a PO or signed schedule. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: I'll draft the deal memo and include the fallback clauses and accelerated payment triggers. Putting this in Deal Desk queue.
Mia Chen: Thanks all — AE will get the draft and loop legal. I'll update this thread with the customer's confirmation. :eyes:
Julia Ramos: Add revenue ops for onboarding note: require quota hold until first invoice paid.
Carla Ng: Noted. If legal okays the auto-revert, finance will route the contract for exec signature.
Mia Chen: AE update (from convo): customer agrees to first invoice net30, accepts auto-revert language. moving to signature.
Samir Patel: Great — marking as approved-by-deal-desk-provisional.
Mia Chen: Closing thread once we have signed schedule. Thanks team! :celebrate:
